scope: TRAIN-only engineering transfer diagnostic, not independent generalization, new association design, or next-stage authorization
target_rule: First registered deterministic first-eligible sole-click episode in each sequence; no error/performance selection; one clicked person in each complete multi-object rollout
initialization: Existing actual RGB OSNet anchor and initial human box; bind the current candidate with highest clicked-box IoU, UID tie-break, minimum0.5. No future GT used. Missing initial candidate is an explicit initialization failure, not a replacement target
candidate_lineage: Same existing TRAIN SAM3/OSNet tapes and frozen GT-free invalid-geometry filtering as N72R21; no new inference, detector tuning, crops or dataset copies
joint_tracker: Existing OpportunityTracker C0/dynamic/raw/P0, bank=None, max_lost_gap90; existing scores, exact joint solver, NONE, births and machine-state updates unchanged
source_models: Each pilot TRAIN sequence's own T2_COUPLED_V1 outer-fold checkpoint, minimum INNER loss; exclude that outer sequence from its six FIT scenes and INNER. All three seeds, no checkpoint selected using pilot, outer or VAL metrics
learned_operating_point: Unchanged joint candidate/NONE argmax, learned current/future-safe thresholds and two-frame confirmation
bridge: Identity proposal from current candidates and actual previously committed state; same existing forced-edge joint solve reassigns all competing public IDs. Hard-infeasible proposal keeps current joint baseline assignment and vetoes proposed memory write; feedback updates identity motion/context to actual committed target observation
proposal_before_write_before_joint_feedb: Provisional cloned identity state shares frozen model; only jointly accepted current crop can commit a proposed write; no GT, hindsight, oracle writes or retroactive changes
distribution_shift: Frozen identity models were not trained on this joint MOT state distribution. Report as transfer diagnostic, not a retrained architecture or proven deployable policy
whole_trajectory: Every original frame, including pre-click; all valid current candidates output exactly once with globally unique public ID per frame. Independently predicted target episodes are never merged
evaluation: All32 scene-case runtime seals verified before future TRAIN GT; pinned official TrackEval same invocation/config for all16 registered cases; save HOTA, AssA, DetA, LocA, IDF1, IDSW, MOTA, FP, FN and target/write/ownership audits
target_statistics: Same clicked target label used only offline; no-click baseline target public ID resolved through its initial clicked-candidate ownership only for evaluator comparison
uncertainty: Two TRAIN sequences cannot establish robust generalization; report actual combined, per-sequence and all seeds, not a selected seed or formal scientific PASS
